meta.title: Allaw — LegalTech platform and tools for legal practices

seo.title: Allaw — Full-stack developer case study
seo.description: Building case management, multi-office profile pages and shared UI components for a LegalTech platform powered by Next.js.

hero.hook: From appointments to cases, a connected legal experience
hero.description: Full-stack work on Allaw: building case management, contributing to multi-office pages and improving public-facing journeys, with a focus on UX and reusable components.

visual.alt: Montage of Allaw interfaces: professional search, appointments and client cases

overview.problem: Legal professionals need to manage cases, appointments and sometimes multiple locations, while clients need a clear public-facing journey.
overview.solution: Built a case-management module linked to the calendar, helped design pages for multi-office structures and created a shared UI component library for the interfaces.
overview.audience: Notaries, lawyers, judicial officers and individuals
overview.role: Full-stack developer, UX/UI design and application architecture
overview.scope: Cases, office pages, booking, search and UI components

architecture.description: Documented application structure: Next.js interfaces, Node.js APIs and MongoDB data serving public and professional workflows.

challenges.title: Building case management from scratch
challenges.constraint: No existing module: data needs, administration screens and the client experience all had to be defined.
challenges.solution: Designed the module end to end, adding responsive interfaces and components consistent with the design system.

challenges.title: Connecting business workflows
challenges.constraint: Client cases could not remain disconnected from appointments already managed in the calendar.
challenges.solution: Linked cases and appointments, connecting case follow-up with scheduling.

challenges.title: Modelling multi-office organisations
challenges.constraint: A firm may run several offices, and a professional may work across multiple locations.
challenges.solution: Designed a shared representation of offices and professionals for the office pages and their map.

challenges.title: Controlling office page editing
challenges.constraint: The person creating a page is not necessarily authorised to manage everything in the organisation.
challenges.solution: Factored invitations and role-based permissions into the design of access to office administration.

outcomes.title: Case management connected to the calendar
outcomes.description: A module built from scratch, with practice interfaces and the ability to link cases to appointments.

outcomes.title: Pages for complex office structures
outcomes.description: Public pages designed to display offices, maps and teams, with office-editing access requirements.

outcomes.title: Reusable UI component library
outcomes.description: An NPM component package expanded over time and available to other frontend developers.
